standard_prerequisites.name: The zeroth K-group of an abelian category equals that of its bounded derived category
The K-group of a bounded derived category with coherent cohomology equals the K-group of the abelian category of coherent sheaves
On a Noetherian scheme D^b(Coh(O_X)) equals D^b_{Coh}(O_X)
standard_prerequisites.use: Alternative argument for the second equality.

core_obligations: First equality: K_0(Coh(O_X)) = K_0(D^b(Coh(O_X))) by the derived categories bounded-derived K-group lemma (proof lines 10092-10093).
Second equality: K_0(Coh(O_X)) = K_0(D^b_{Coh}(O_X)) by the derived categories DBA map K lemma (proof lines 10094-10096).
Alternative: the second equality can also be read off from the equality D^b(Coh(O_X)) = D^b_{Coh}(O_X) given by the DCoh proposition (proof lines 10098-10101).
proof_roadmap: Apply the bounded-derived K-group lemma for the first equality (proof lines 10092-10093).
Apply the DBA K-group lemma for the second equality (proof lines 10094-10096).
Note the alternative route via the DCoh proposition (proof lines 10098-10101).
